interview.hardest_part: Surviving the first night reliably: recognizing the approaching darkness, gathering grass/twigs/logs, and crafting/placing a torch or campfire before Charlie kills me.
interview.likely_failure: Most likely failure is dying on the first or second night due to missed light/crafting, or starving later because I cannot reliably identify and harvest food while managing inventory across screenshots.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Long daylight gives time to gather; berries and carrots provide early food; contextual Space action and inventory hotkeys reduce control complexity; map and camera rotation aid navigation; continuous survival rewards cautious play.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Real-time hunger/sanity drain and instant darkness death; crafting UI and recipe requirements are hard to read and execute from screenshots; no right-click input limits some actions; combat and kiting are risky; long multi-day survival demands sustained low-error play.
